name: s81dv_rg3b_xm6
structural_change: STW-S81e-XR 10-23 (GEOM-REVIEW FAIL fix (a)): lw_* landing writes now land in N-face pin registers + one landing register per SRAM at its write faces (LWL 2: +2 write-visibility edges, booked MU.S81.CAL; lockstep vs the flat X with the same write edges, mut7 = landing bypass caught). No macro pin is wired to a tile port any more (bank_distance n/a). STW-S81c-TOK4-BAND 10-22 (STEWARD-S81c item, MU.BAL.SX.3): idx rg3 clock-rule successor. rg3p / rg3nqq2 hung 27-32k sinks on ONE ck over 1.04 x 1.21 mm (TT spread 223-233 ps; k-means under one port cannot fix it). The reader is cut at existing registers into 4 hard bands (R control / X response + landing + key mux / S01 / S23 engine halves), each its own small tree with registered faces, under an lp.py landed parent (D2/E1, +2 edges a crossing; cut analysis results/arch/s81_band_1022/cut_analysis.json: every seam <= 0.16 of its tracks). Flat band composition = dsdv_idx_rg3 #(IH 0, OH 1, KR 1) cycle-exact (tb lockstep); landed = flat + 2-edge landings (lp.py lockstep) with LX 8 / PD 2.

job.purpose: banded idx rg3 X successor: SRAM / key tile, ONE S pin-flop band, select capture replicated (census)

pin_regs.reason: band of the banded idx rg3: source-registered faces (every band input lands in a flop, every output leaves one: the landed parent's ring / read halves sit outside); a recipe pin stage would add an unpriced edge on the landed schedule (lp record).

why_floorplan: SRAM tile of the X cluster (475.2 x 432 under xn): 8 SRAM in 2 columns x 4 rows (90.72 pitch: 20-um channels, the v1 SRAM LEF only sits on the snapped macro lattice so it cannot abut; y 43.2 .. 385.8: 43-um S halo over the kq pin band, 46-um N halo under the lw_* face); h0 column R0 at x 43.2 (read pins on the 43-um W channel), h1 column MY at x 257.04 (read pins on the E channel): each key half reads only its own column, so its mux runs down its own channel to the kq pin flops; write pins of both columns face the 39-um centre gap.  The ONLY pin-flop band is kq on the S face, with the S-stage capture flops (sx_i pins beside the clock; raw scale select replicated 8x) in the same band; default tree.
outline_reason: 8 SRAM abutted 2x4 (pitch 70.512); centre read channel 82.08 (both LEF-W read/write-lo faces, M3+M5 ~3,460 tracks vs <= 1,890 b crossing, 0.55 pessimistic / 0.25 with the column OR-chain); outer channels 24.6 um (120 b wd hi + landing regs); N 46 um (1,080 lw pin regs + fan-out to 8 SRAM landing), S 23.8 um (544 kq pin regs)

unregistered_ok.sx_i: R's S-stage read select: drives the landing SRAM read enable/row through 1-2 gates; the macro's synchronous read port is the capture register (band schedule edge, frozen)
